{"bash_command":"git","full_command":"git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
test(axiathon-client): add failing tests for Story 6.1 CLI framework

RED phase: 71 failing tests across 7 test files covering all 10 ACs.
Also fixes 11 pre-existing tautological/vacuous tests in axiathon-core.

Test files:
- cli_commands.rs: command groups, help rendering, global flags (AC-1,2,5,6)
- exit_codes.rs: CliError exit code mapping + CWE-209 checks (AC-3)
- output_format.rs: table/JSON/CSV formatting + TTY detection (AC-4)
- siem_client.rs: HTTP wrapper, headers, status mapping (AC-7)
- config_loading.rs: TOML loading, env overrides, validation (AC-8)
- shell_completion.rs: bash/zsh/fish/powershell generation (AC-9)
- stub_handlers.rs: unimplemented command stubs (AC-10)

Pre-existing fixes in axiathon-core:
- Replace tautological error propagation tests with real From/? chains
- Delete struct field read-back tests (compiler-guaranteed)
- Fix incomplete api_meta_all_fields_optional assertion
- Fix tenant_id_new_rejects_too_long to verify Validation variant
- Fix time-ordering tests to use strict less-than with retry loop
EOF
)"","description":"Commit failing tests"}
